what_works: Project documented through white-cube architectural photography — every shot is symmetrical, daylit, deeply quiet. The compositional lesson: shoot the work, not the worker; let the empty room or clean roof speak. Cleaning crews and roofers with strong 'after' photography can borrow the symmetry-and-daylight crop discipline.
what_does_not_translate: It's a print/case study presentation, not a live site interaction model — translate the photo crops and the silent palette, the site shell itself is yours to build.
type_observations: Restrained editorial serif at large hero size + small disciplined grotesk body; barely any color, all rhythm.
